description: Open intern and new-grad roles, newest posting first. Returns {data: Role[], next_cursor, total}. Pass next_cursor back as cursor for the next page. Page size is up to 20 without an API key and 100 with one. Without a Realtime key, roles first detected within the Free plan's delay (minutes in the server instructions) are left out, and employer_url and ats_job_id are null. include_evidence (Realtime) adds the posting sentences behind the sponsorship, citizenship, clearance and graduation fields.

citizenship.description: "not_required" hides roles whose posting requires US citizenship or US-person status (eligibility.citizenship_required true). Roles not read yet stay in. With include_clearance=true it keeps clearance roles that state no citizenship requirement. REST: citizenship.

company.description: Exact company name as list_companies returns it. REST: company.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, an array or a comma-separated string. Setting it replaces the US-only default. REST: country.

degree.description: Keep roles open to this degree program: a posting that names the degrees it accepts must include it; one naming none stays in. REST: degree.

exclude_companies.description: Company names to leave out; an array or a comma-separated string. REST: exclude.

graduation_year.description: Hide roles whose graduation window excludes this year. REST: grad.

group.description: Company group slugs from list_groups, any of them; an array or a comma-separated string. REST: group.

include_clearance.description: Default false hides roles requiring US citizenship, US-person status or a clearance. REST: clearance=1.

posted_after.description: ISO 8601 time; only roles posted at or after it.

query.description: Text the role title or company name contains, matched as one phrase. REST: q.

since.description: Only roles posted within this window. REST: since.

sponsorship.description: For an applicant who needs visa sponsorship. "needed" hides roles whose posting says no sponsorship; roles that do not say, or are not read yet, stay in. "available" keeps only roles whose posting says it sponsors. REST: sponsorship.

track.description: Any of these tracks, as an array or a comma-separated string. "swe" covers frontend, backend and fullstack. REST: track.

undergrad.description: true hides roles that accept only graduate degrees. REST: undergrad=1, or degree=bachelors.

us_only.description: Default true: roles open to US applicants. false lifts it. REST: us=0.

workplace.description: Workplace types, any of them; an array or a comma-separated string. REST: workplace.
